# Add a router strategy

## Procedure

1. Review router requirements and model configuration in [AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md).
2. Follow the router's existing strategy interface and keep model names in configuration.
3. Add focused pytest coverage for the strategy and its edge cases.
4. Run the router tests and lint checks.

The router implementation is not in place yet.
